agent.title: Agent
agent.sectionSubtitle: Runtime options for simulation agents. Like Claude Code: common settings are visible; the rest live in collapsible panels. Saved to workspace .env with the main Save action.
agent.contextPresetStandardHint: For everyday runs: tighter compaction and smaller tool-result budgets—predictable cost and latency.
agent.contextPresetLongHint: For long tasks and skill-heavy loops: larger thread and tool budgets. Confirm your model/API supports ~1M context.

tools.sectionHint: Always-on tools cannot be turned off. Switches below control which tools PersonAgent can see and call during a simulation step.
tools.disableableNote: Disable via AGENT_DISABLED_TOOLS: {{names}} (Bash uses AGENT_ALLOW_BASH_TOOL separately)

expert.entryHint: Usually leave as-is. Context preset, per-step limits, and built-in tools. Saved with the main config to .env.
expert.modalHint: Blank numeric fields are not written to .env—the preset defaults apply. Each item below explains what it does.
expert.warningIntro: Misconfiguration can break runs, increase cost, or leave extra data in the workspace.
expert.riskCost: Large context windows, tool rounds, or timeouts can sharply increase token cost and latency.
expert.riskStability: Mismatched window vs. model may cause truncation, compaction issues, or mid-run failures.
expert.riskTools: Disabling Bash, codegen/write/batch tools, or dynamic skill commands can break tool-dependent runs.
expert.riskOverride: Filled values override the corresponding preset defaults.

contextPreset.label: Context preset
contextPreset.help: Applies a bundled profile: context window, compaction thresholds, summary and tool-result budgets. Enough for most users.

contextWindow.label: Context window (tokens)
contextWindow.help: Overrides the preset window used for budgeting. Leave blank to follow the preset entirely.

maxToolRounds.label: Max tool rounds per step
maxToolRounds.help: Cap on tool/skill invocations per simulation step. Higher values slow steps and cost more. Blank → default 24.

stepTimeout.label: Step timeout (seconds)
stepTimeout.help: Total time budget per simulation step. Blank → default 600s.

llmRequestTimeout.label: LLM request timeout (seconds)
llmRequestTimeout.help: Per-completion timeout. 0 disables per-request timeout. Blank → default 120s.

checkpointInterval.label: Checkpoint interval (steps)
checkpointInterval.help: How often checkpoints are written. Blank → every 10 steps.

allowBash.label: Bash tool
allowBash.help: Allow Bash in the workspace (still policy-guarded). Off → skills/files only. Default on.

allowDynamicSkills.label: Dynamic skill commands
allowDynamicSkills.help: Allow runtime skill commands from packages. Off → fixed tool set only. Default on.

profileMaxChars.label: Profile max characters
profileMaxChars.help: Truncation before profile enters the identity prompt; also affects surveys. Blank → preset (≈4k standard, ≈8k long).

eqFieldMaxChars.label: Survey field max characters
eqFieldMaxChars.help: Per-field cap in external-question context JSON. Blank → preset.

eqContextMaxChars.label: Survey context JSON max characters
eqContextMaxChars.help: Total size cap for context JSON in survey prompts. Blank → preset.

eqMemoryLimit.label: Survey memory entries
eqMemoryLimit.help: How many recent memory lines to attach when answering surveys. Blank → preset.

eqToolLogsLimit.label: Survey tool-log entries
eqToolLogsLimit.help: How many recent tool logs to attach. Blank → preset.

eqThreadLimit.label: Survey thread messages
eqThreadLimit.help: How many recent thread messages to attach. Blank → preset.

enableLlmHistory.label: Record LLM history
enableLlmHistory.help: Persist LLM traffic under the workspace for debugging. Uses more disk. Default off.

llmHistoryMaxEntries.label: LLM history max entries
llmHistoryMaxEntries.help: Retention cap when history is enabled. Blank → default 100.

advanced.runtimeHint: Override loop, timeout, and tool capability defaults. Leave blank to omit from .env and keep preset defaults.
advanced.surveyHint: Limits for PersonAgent external questionnaires (profile and context truncation).
advanced.debugHint: Enable LLM history only when debugging (uses extra disk).

skillManagement.title: Skill Management
skillManagement.subtitle: Manage Agent skills used in simulation and Claude folder skills. Toggles apply immediately; turning off does not delete files on disk.
skillManagement.agentTabIntroBody: Same capabilities the simulation uses. This tab needs the local backend to read the runtime registry, enable/disable, reload, scan, or import agent skills. “Built-in” ships with the product; “Workspace” lists skills you imported or installed from the marketplace. The toggle controls whether a skill loads at runtime. Archive moves a skill out of regular use without deleting its files.
skillManagement.claudeTabIntroBody: One combined list: bundled templates appear first—use Sync to workspace to copy them into the project. Other rows are folders already on your machine. Syncing does not remove skills you installed from the marketplace.
skillManagement.purgeClaudeConfirmContent: This removes “{{name}}” from disk. You cannot turn it back on from this page. To hide it temporarily, use Deactivate instead.
skillManagement.archiveAgentConfirmContent: “{{name}}” will be archived and taken out of regular use. Files stay in your workspace; to use it again, move the folder back and run Scan workspace for agent skills.
skillManagement.agentBackendRequiredNotice: Agent runtime skill management depends on the local backend. Without it, you can still browse/install Claude Code skills, edit configuration files, and inspect local experiment outputs; agent skill listing, toggles, reload, scan, and import require starting the backend first.
skillManagement.claudeWorkspaceExplain: Applies only to the folder you have open; marketplace installs and imports usually land here.
skillManagement.claudeGlobalExplain: Shared across projects—good for skills you use everywhere.
skillManagement.vsixTemplateExplain: Sample copies included with the extension for preview; use Sync to workspace to use them in this project.

skillManagement.githubTokenDesc: Optional. Fill in your GitHub Personal Access Token to authenticate API requests and avoid the anonymous rate limit (60 req/hour). Only public_repo scope is needed.

claudeCodeConfig.subtitle: Manage official sign-in, third-party providers, and local proxy routing for Claude Code and Codex.
claudeCodeConfig.subtitleSplit: Claude Code and Codex use different APIs and config files. Configure providers and local proxy in each section below.
claudeCodeConfig.subtitleClaude: Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages) → ~/.claude/settings.json. Keep proxy off for Pro/Max subscription and run claude /login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.subtitleCodex: OpenAI Responses API (/v1/responses) → ~/.codex/config.toml and auth.json. Keep proxy off for ChatGPT subscription and run codex login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayCodexProtocol: Protocol: OpenAI Responses API (POST /v1/responses) → Codex config
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayClaudeSectionHint: For Anthropic/third-party providers with an API Key only. Keep off for Pro/Max subscription; use claude /login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayCodexSectionHint: For OpenAI/third-party providers with an API Key only. Keep off for ChatGPT subscription; use codex login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.providersClaudeHint: Claude can use native Anthropic providers or OpenAI-compatible providers through the local gateway bridge.
claudeCodeConfig.providersCodexHint: OpenAI / Responses-compatible providers. After saving a default provider, Codex reads the new model and routing config on next start.
claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexModelConfigHint: Used as the default Codex model. For third-party providers, enter a model they actually support.
claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexModelUpstreamHint: Enter an API key to fetch models, or type the model name manually. If empty, the provider preset chooses a default model.
claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexModelPlaceholder: e.g. gpt-5-codex (leave empty for subscription; codex login picks the model)
claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexModelSubscriptionDefault: Subscription uses model from codex login
claudeCodeConfig.modelMappingTip: Map your provider's models to Claude's role aliases (sonnet/opus/haiku)
claudeCodeConfig.modelHotSwitchClaudeHint: Saving updates Claude Code defaults. In a running Claude session, use /model to switch immediately without losing context.
claudeCodeConfig.modelHotSwitchCodexHint: Saving updates Codex config.toml. Codex usually reads model lists and mappings at startup, so restart Codex after changing them.
claudeCodeConfig.modelContextClaudeHint: Claude long-context support depends on the model, account, and provider API. If your provider offers a 1M or long-context model, choose that model; otherwise use the standard-context option.
claudeCodeConfig.selectFromListOrType: Pick from list or type manually
claudeCodeConfig.autoMapDone: Filled empty mapping fields from model IDs
claudeCodeConfig.modelsFetchHint: Fetch available models from Base URL (GET /v1/models). Compatible gateways return the catalog for dropdown selection.

modelsFetchErrors.missing_credentials: Enter Base URL and API Key first
modelsFetchErrors.auth_failed: Authentication failed — check your API Key
modelsFetchErrors.models_not_supported: This gateway has no GET /v1/models (type model IDs manually)
modelsFetchErrors.empty_list: The API returned an empty model list
modelsFetchErrors.network_error: Network error — check that Base URL is reachable
modelsFetchErrors.request_failed: Could not reach the models endpoint

claudeCodeConfig.permissionModeTip: Controls the permission mode when Claude Code starts. 'Bypass Permissions' auto-approves all tool calls, suitable for automation.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayHint: The local gateway only proxies third-party providers with an API Key. Pro/Max and ChatGPT subscriptions should keep the gateway off and use OAuth direct login. Choose proxy routes before enabling; subscription-only sides show "Subscription direct" and cannot be toggled on.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayActiveNote: Gateway enabled. Save after changing upstream API. Restart CLI tool sessions after toggling the gateway.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedCredentials: Enter upstream Base URL and API Key first
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedAnthropicProvider: Add Anthropic official (subscription) or a compatible Claude provider first
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedAnthropicApiForProxy: Claude Pro/Max uses OAuth and cannot go through the local gateway. Turn off Claude proxy or use a provider with an API Key.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayCodexNeedOpenAiProvider: Codex official subscription needs no API Key; add OpenAI official and run codex login
claudeCodeConfig.providerClaudeOpenAiBridgeHint: Claude Code connects to the local gateway; the gateway converts Anthropic Messages requests to an OpenAI Chat/Responses-compatible upstream.
claudeCodeConfig.providerOpenAiHint: For Codex CLI. Official subscription needs no API Key — run codex login after saving. Third-party gateways need an API Key.
claudeCodeConfig.providerClaudeSubscriptionHint: Claude Pro/Max subscription: no API Key. After saving as Claude default, run claude in the terminal and /login when prompted.
claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexSubscriptionHint: ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription: no API Key. After saving as Codex default, run codex login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayRouteClaudeViaProxy: Route Claude Code via local gateway
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayRouteSelectHint: Checked tools use the local gateway when it is enabled; unchecked or subscription-only tools stay on OAuth/API direct. At least one proxy route must stay on while the gateway runs.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayRoutePickBeforeEnable: Select at least one tool to proxy, or enable the gateway to auto-select available API providers.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNoApiProviderHint: All providers are official subscriptions — no local gateway is needed or available. Add a provider with an API Key to proxy a third-party API.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayTopologyHint: Claude Code and Codex keep separate routing and config files. Providers are shared; Claude can use native Anthropic APIs or OpenAI-compatible upstreams.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedRoute: Select at least one tool to route through the local gateway
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedCodexProvider: Add OpenAI official (Codex subscription) or a third-party OpenAI provider first
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedCodexApiForProxy: ChatGPT subscription uses codex login and cannot go through the local gateway. Turn off Codex proxy or use a Platform API Key.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayCodexAuthHint: Codex local routing is configured. The real upstream key stays in this extension's provider settings.
claudeCodeConfig.protocolCompareHint: The two CLIs use different protocols and config files; the local gateway routes by request path.
claudeCodeConfig.protocolClaudeItem: Claude Code: ~/.claude/settings.json, Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages). Pro/Max subscription uses OAuth (/login); third-party gateways use ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
claudeCodeConfig.protocolCodexItem: Codex: ~/.codex/config.toml + auth.json, OpenAI Responses API (/v1/responses). ChatGPT subscription uses codex login; Platform API uses OPENAI_API_KEY
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayPortRangeHint: Picks the first free port from 15721–15820; enable fails if none are available
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayHintUpstreamFromProvider: When the gateway is enabled, the upstream API is determined by the active provider below. Use provider management to add or switch upstream.
claudeCodeConfig.providerListHint: Toggle on to set as the default provider for that role; toggle off to switch to the next available. One primary per role, the rest serve as failover backups.
claudeCodeConfig.providerCenterHint: Each provider can serve both Claude Code and Codex. Toggle on to set as default, off to remove. One primary provider per role.
claudeCodeConfig.providerNeedOne: Add and activate at least one Claude provider
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayNeedActiveProvider: Add and activate a provider with Base URL and API Key first
claudeCodeConfig.providerQueryQuotaCodexHint: Reads ChatGPT subscription quota from ~/.codex/auth.json (run codex login first)

providerUsageErrors.codex_not_logged_in: Codex is not logged in. Run codex login in the terminal first.

claudeCodeConfig.providerEmpty: No providers yet — click Add provider to get started
claudeCodeConfig.failoverHint: When the current provider has a network error, rate limit, or temporary service issue, try another provider of the same type. Official subscription direct mode is not part of failover.
claudeCodeConfig.failoverSummary: Claude candidates: {{claude}}. Codex candidates: {{codex}}. Applies only to tools using the local proxy.
claudeCodeConfig.usageNoData: No proxied usage yet. Future requests will be tracked and retained automatically.
claudeCodeConfig.usageCostIncludesCache: Cost estimates price input, output, cache reads, and cache writes separately. Codex/OpenAI-compatible records subtract cache hits from billable input before pricing cache reads.
claudeCodeConfig.usageTrendNeedMore: The trend appears after usage is recorded on at least two dates
claudeCodeConfig.usagePricingHint: Common models match built-in reference prices. The gateway also tries OpenRouter and LiteLLM for current observed models and caches those prices. Override relay prices here per million tokens (USD).
claudeCodeConfig.providerAddHint: Native Anthropic providers serve Claude Code only; OpenAI-compatible providers can serve both Claude Code and Codex.
claudeCodeConfig.failoverProviderHint: When enabled, this provider will serve as a failover node if the primary becomes unavailable
claudeCodeConfig.failoverSelectBackups: Select failover backup providers (click to toggle):
